title: Doc Upload Match
summary: Checks an uploaded file against the document asked for, so a KYC upload isn't rejected days later for being the wrong side, locked or blurry.
description: Checks a file against the document asked for (Aadhaar back instead of front, Aadhaar in the PAN slot, a password-locked e-Aadhaar PDF, a multi-page PDF, a tiny, blurry or HEIC photo, a screenshot of a screenshot) using in-browser signals plus an optional classify hook.
catches: Password-locked PDFs, with how the e-Aadhaar password is formed
Multi-page PDFs where one page is expected
Images too small, blurry or in HEIC format
The wrong document or side, when you provide a classify function
limits: Without a classify hook it can't tell which document is in the image
Blur and size checks are heuristics and can misjudge some photos
Runs in the browser; the file still goes wherever your onAccept sends it
a11y: Labelled file picker; focus returns to it after a rejection
The preview image has empty alt (decorative); status is given in text
Checking and result messages use icons plus text
server: Re-validate document type, size and content on the server or with your KYC provider; client checks are hints.

rules.note: Not verified on 2026-10-17: the UIDAI site did not respond. The e-Aadhaar password rule (first 4 letters of the name in capitals + birth year) is unchecked.
